0022600099.text: The Bulls (0-1, 15th in the East, 5th in the Central, 1 game back) are coming off a road loss, and the Bucks (0-1, 13th in the East, 4th in the Central, 1 game back) also dropped their only game so far, which was on the road. Chicago's unavailable players are Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, Josh Giddey, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins, who are listed as day-to-day with illness, illness, no reason given, a knee sprain and a quadriceps injury, respectively. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 1-3, though Chicago won the most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026.
